title: Manure Applications and Soil Compaction: An In-Depth Analysis
reason: Describes the effects of manure application on soil properties and compaction.

tasks.task: Explain the differences in manure application rates and their impacts on soil compaction and organic matter.

subtasks.text: Highlight the decrease in bulk density with manure application rate increase in the top four inches of soil.
Note the little impact of manure on bulk density in the subsurface (8 inches) compared to the surface.

tasks.task: Discuss the impact of manure on soil structure and macropore presence.

subtasks.text: Show the increase in aggregation and macropore presence with manure application.
Highlight the negative effect of high nitrogen fertilizer on soil structure and macropore presence.

tasks.task: Explain the relationship between soil health scores and crop yield.

subtasks.text: Present the correlation between soil health scores and crop yields for manure and fertilizer applications.

tasks.task: Describe the impact of disturbance factors on soil compaction and structure.

subtasks.text: Show greater box density in no-till systems compared to conventional till systems.
Highlight the effect of tillage on larger aggregate sizes and the overall soil structure.
Demonstrate the influence of manure on smaller aggregates and its stability in no-till systems.
